pages.title: Treasure Finder
pages.text: Right-click to sweep a 9 x 9 chunk area around you for unlooted chests. Found loot is highlighted in the world for a short time.

$(bold)Details$()$(br)The dowser detects chests that still have an unopened loot table, within 4 chunks in every direction. It has 64 uses and a short cooldown after each sweep.$(br2)The Left and Right Half items are inert fragments with no power of their own.
